temperature.why_zh: 控制采样随机性。较高更发散，较低更集中；数值不是准确率保证。
temperature.why_en: Controls sampling randomness. Higher is more varied; lower is more focused, not a guarantee of accuracy.

top_p.why_zh: 保留累计概率范围；与温度共同作用，过低可能损失表达选择。
top_p.why_en: Retains a cumulative probability mass. Works with temperature; too low can narrow expression.

top_k.why_zh: 每步候选token数量，候选越多不等于更聪明。
top_k.why_en: Limits candidate tokens per step; more candidates do not imply better reasoning.

min_p.why_zh: 相对最高概率token的过滤阈值；0表示不增加此层过滤。
min_p.why_en: Relative probability filter; zero disables this extra filter.

repeat_penalty.why_zh: 1表示不追加重复惩罚；提高可能减少复述，也可能损害术语、人物名和代码重复。
repeat_penalty.why_en: One adds no repetition penalty. Higher may reduce loops but also distort repeated terms, names, or code.

threads.why_zh: CPU推理线程。i7-12700F为8P+4E/20线程；线程越多并不必然越快。
threads.why_en: CPU inference threads. The i7-12700F has 8 P + 4 E cores / 20 threads; more is not always faster.

cacheRam.why_zh: 空闲提示词缓存预算（MiB），不是GPU KV显存。更大有利于多会话复用，也会增加系统内存压力。
cacheRam.why_en: Idle prompt-cache budget in MiB, not GPU KV VRAM. Larger budgets can reuse more sessions but consume system RAM.

reasoning_budget.why_zh: 思考token预算，不是正文输出上限。提高可能帮助复杂推理，也可能增加等待；关闭思考时预算不等于启用开关。
reasoning_budget.why_en: Thinking-token budget, not the content-output limit. More may help difficult reasoning but can increase latency; it is not the thinking-mode switch.
